Name: Sandy Nude Version
Author: RamboltSvk
Description:
Remake of Sandy's portrait into nude version.

How to install : Simply drop the content folder into the :\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits
(Back up the original Sandy.xnb file incase of errors)

How to uninstall : Simply remove the Sandy.xnb file and replace it with the original Sandy.xnb file
(If Steam is in use verifying the game cache all changed textures will go back to normal)

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
